# MD Anwar — Analytics & Finance-Intelligence Consultant

> Business Intelligence Specialist (AWS) and analytics consultant turning large-scale loyalty and finance data into decisions CFOs and loyalty directors can act on. Based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

This is the professional portfolio of MD Anwar, currently Business Intelligence Specialist (AWS) at Loyalty Juggernaut (Aug 2025–present) and formerly Data Engineer at ADP National Account Services (Dec 2022–Aug 2025).

## About

MD Anwar builds AWS-native BI systems, IFRS 15-compliant finance intelligence platforms, and enterprise reconciliation frameworks for loyalty programs with 10M+ members. He owns the enterprise data warehouse and BI layer for two flagship global loyalty programs, delivering analytics and finance intelligence across airline, hospitality, retail, and banking ecosystems.

## Key Achievements

- Rebuilt the stepped-model reimbursement algorithm for the world's largest hotel alliance, reducing daily runtime from ~26 hours to ~2 hours (~6× faster) by consolidating two pipelines into a single gold core table. Earned Juggernaut of the Month (Aug 2026) and CEO commendation.
- Surfaced ~85.5M MXN in under-reported breakage by root-causing a 6-month data integrity gap in a loyalty finance dashboard. Validated core points engine to 99.84% accuracy.
- Re-architected billing-critical reconciliation to 100% daily accuracy with 0 missing records and proactive alerting, closing a years-long escalation.
- Builds and maintains 250+ dashboards across 13 enterprise clients. Segments 13M+ members weekly into 6 behavioral groups.
- BI engineer on Fidivio — the world's first IFRS 15-compliant loyalty accounting platform. Writes the Redshift SQL behind its API payloads and the Python liability and breakage-forecasting engines.
